BrochureContent.Content:
Set on an impressive elevated Site of 0.5 Acres, this beautifully maintained four-bedroom detached Bungalow offers the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living and modern-day convenience, just one mile from the thriving town of Ballyhaunis. Presented in exceptional condition throughout, the property reflects the care and attention of its current owners, who have maintained the home to an outstanding standard with quality and comfort at the forefront of every detail.

Approached by a beautiful tree lined avenue driveway and surrounded by mature landscaped Gardens, the property immediately creates a welcoming first impression. The spacious outdoor setting provides privacy, generous parking and excellent space for family living, entertaining or simply enjoying the tranquillity of the countryside.

Internally the home is bright, spacious and thoughtfully designed to suit modern family life. A welcoming Entrance Hallway   leads to a large comfortable Sitting Room featuring a beautiful Bay Window that fills the space with an abundance of natural light which creates a warm and relaxing atmosphere. The fully fitted Kitchen offers excellent storage and workspace, while the adjoining living room provides an ideal family gathering area for everyday living and entertaining alike.

There are four generously proportioned Bedrooms, all complete with fitted Wardrobes, ensuring excellent storage throughout. The master Bedroom benefits from a private En-Suite Bathroom, while a well-positioned family Bathroom in relation to the other 3 Bedrooms and Utility Room add further practicality to the layout.

A standout of this property is the large detached Garage at the rear, offering superb versatility for a variety of uses including a Workshop, Car port or storage area. Complete with Toilet facilities, this impressive building adds significant value and functionality to the home.

The location combines the charm of rural living with excellent accessibility. Situated close to Ireland West International Airport Knock and within easy reach of both Galway and Sligo, the property is ideally positioned for commuters and families alike. Ballyhaunis itself offers a wide range of amenities including Schools, Shops, Restaurants, sporting facilities and public transport links including the main Railway Line from Dublin to Westport.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a superb family home in a highly convenient yet wonderfully peaceful setting, where space, comfort and quality come together effortlessly.
